title: Why Are Gamers Upset About Sony's PS5?

scenes.text: Sony's PS5 has sparked controversy among gamers

scenes.label: DIGITAL ONLY
scenes.text: The company plans to drop PlayStation discs in favor of digital-only games

scenes.label: GAME PRESERVATION
scenes.text: Gamers are concerned about game preservation and ownership

scenes.label: FAN BACKLASH
scenes.text: The backlash has led to a planned PS5 blackout by fans
Follow if tech moves faster than you can keep up.

description: Sony's PS5 has sparked controversy among gamers due to the company's plans to drop PlayStation discs in favor of digital-only games. Gamers are concerned about game preservation and ownership, leading to a planned PS5 blackout by fans. Follow us for more gaming news.
